long_biography.plain_text:
At Maximon, Tobias Reichmuth applies company-building methods to preventive health and longevity. The Swiss venture builder works with scientists and operators to turn research into businesses, including Avea and Ayun. Reichmuth's role is not only to supply capital: Maximon describes its founders as operational co-founders who help shape ventures from formation through commercial growth.

That approach extends a career built around making emerging themes investable. He founded SUSI Partners in 2009 around energy-transition infrastructure, then co-founded The Singularity Group, an innovation-investment boutique. Reichmuth studied at the University of St Gallen and earned a Dr. rer. pol. from the European Business School in Oestrich-Winkel. In 2026, St Gallen named him its Founder of the Year.
